0. FOREWORD
the Indian Standards finalized by the Textile Committee had been

0.1 This Indian Standard was adopt& by Institution on 15 October 1979, after the draft Mill Accessories ( Other Than Jute ) Sectional approved by the Textile Division Council.

0.2 This standard is based on the findings of mill trials of shuttles made of indigenous timbers vis-a-vis imported timbers carried out by Forest Research Institute, Dehra Dun in collaboration with IS1 and is in line with the manufacturing practices followed in the country in this field. 0.3 Since the dimensions of the shuttles vary to" a great extent depending on the make of loom, this standard recommends the dimensions of blocks from which shuttles of various dimensions can be manufactured. 0.4 For the purpose of deci&@ &&&her a particular requirement of this standard is complied with, the final value, observed or calculated, off in accordance expressing the, result of a test, shall be rounded The number of significant places retained in the with IS : 2-1960*. rounded off value should be the same as that of the specified value in this standard.
